notes.title: Patch note 1.0.1
notes.notes:
- Red orbs now destroy XP orbs on contact to avoid visual clutter.
- Red orbs are more likely to spawn away from XP orbs.
- Increased red orb spawn rate to balance their new positioning.
- Fixed the translation for the "Attract all orbs" ability.
- Fixed a leaderboard bug where texts could overlap.
- Dash speed is now consistent in all directions.
- Timer now stops slightly earlier upon death for better accuracy.
- Explosion effects now spawn more reliably and consistently.
- Fixed an issue where level length wasn’t calculated correctly.
- Reduced level length by 40% to increase game pacing.
- Stats panel now shows more detailed information, including fixed player movement speed values.
- New passive added: "XP Orb Move Speed Boost".
- New music track added to the game.
- Leaderboard values fixed: removed the timer tab and now sorting by world level, then timer.
- Improved procedural generation to reduce empty levels and improve enemy and item spawning accuracy.
- Split spinning lasers into two separate, easier enemies for better difficulty balance.

For more details, post suggestions, report bugs and much more, join Glow Journey's Discord server: https://discord.com/invite/UFSu6354ky
